_comment: What each release branch is allowed to differ from `main` in.
This file lives on `main` and is merged forward unchanged, so the set of
paths a branch may diverge in is decided where the rule is written rather
than on the branch it constrains. Adding an entry is a design decision:
every path here is one more place two branches can become two products.
A path may appear here and be identical anyway — src/lib/k8s.ts is one of
the three shims and so is permitted to differ, but no branch has needed to
change it. Listing it says what is allowed, not what is true today.
